animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Start from the exact supplied low kneeling crouch guard pose and end in the exact supplied wide low crouching elbow-strike pose. Animate ONE direct, forceful, aggressive low horizontal elbow strike (no slow dancing or waving arms), pure body motion only in completely empty air around the fighter: staying low on the ground baseline without standing up, Pippo does only a tight, compact wind-up coiling his torso and tucking his lead left elbow tightly back; then he lunges aggressively forward along the ground into the wide low stance while driving a powerful, direct horizontal left elbow strike straight to the right (forearm folded tightly across his chest, elbow leading forward, rear right arm extended down-back for counterbalance), landing firmly in the exact supplied final elbow-strike pose. Preserve exact face, beard, flannel, jeans, boots, scale and pixel art. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, clean sprite only.
